data.title: Income tax assessment 2025 – refund of €550
data.summary: Finanzamt Beispielstadt issued the 2025 income tax assessment dated 27 February 2026. Tax is set at €8,990.00 against €9,540.00 withheld, giving a refund of €550.00.
data.explanation: This is your tax assessment (Steuerbescheid) for 2025. You paid more wage tax than needed, so you get €550.00 back, which will be credited to your bank account. Check that the figures match your records. If you disagree, you may file an objection (Einspruch) in writing, electronically or in person at the tax office. The app shows the deadline for this. Otherwise nothing needs to be done. A tax adviser can help if you are unsure.
